item.title: insomniac 0.1.1
item.description:
Merge feat/W16-dark-control-theming: dark-mode theming for stock WPF controls
Owner-reported: WPF's built-in Button/RadioButton/CheckBox/ComboBox/ToggleButton render in the classic light Aero theme regardless of OS dark mode, so they sat as light-gray chrome on insomniac's dark glass flyout; Until... was clipped. Adds Controls.xaml - implicit app-scoped styles deriving chrome from each control's Foreground (correct in both themes, re-brushes on reopen), an opaque dropdown ground, and a segmented duration picker that fits Until... at 320px. Amber stays lamp-only; switches monochrome; rounded, no chamfer. 189 tests green, CI 34764462916. Review: Approve; selected-pill opacity nit applied. Final look sign-off is the owner's.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

item.title: insomniac 0.1.0
item.description: First Windows release. insomniac keeps you active in presence-aware apps like Teams, Slack and Zoom by resetting the system idle timer with an invisible key event, and can also keep the display and system awake. Per-user install, no admin rights. v0.1 is not code-signed: SmartScreen will warn - choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
